SurvFitSummary: Survival Extrapolation with Standard Parametric and Spline Models

Source: R/SurvFitSummary-package.R
SurvFitSummary-package.Rd

Prepares time-to-event data with processing_dataset, summarises them with Kaplan-Meier estimates (summarise_data, km_table), Cox proportional hazards models (estimate_hazard_ratio), the Grambsch-Therneau test (test_proportional_hazards) and smoothed empirical hazards (estimate_empirical_hazard). Test data can be simulated with generate_dummy_survival_data.

Standard parametric and Royston-Parmar spline models are fitted with fit_survival_models, and their results are reported by parameter_table, covariance_table, gof_table, predict_survival, survival_summary and spline_knot_table.

The plots are plot_km, plot_empirical_hazard, plot_survival_fits, plot_hazard_fits, plot_distribution_diagnostics, plot_schoenfeld and plot_qq_survival.

The results are written to an Excel workbook by write_survival_workbook and to a Word report by write_survival_report. The vignettes describe the analysis (vignette("SurvFitSummary")), the models (vignette("models", package = "SurvFitSummary")) and the validation of the package (vignette("validation", package = "SurvFitSummary")).
